goals.calibration: HONEST 3 (NOT 5–8 — charter delta: gateway is routing/proxy, lowest-domain-logic service; do NOT manufacture primitives to hit a count). Confirmed pure-function units in brownfield source: (1) overall-status-computer — computeOverallStatus(statuses map)→HealthStatus, pkg/domain/services.go, currently unexported; (2) proxy-path-resolver — ProxyPath(reqPath,svc)→path, pkg/interface/http/handlers.go, already exported+tested; (3) route-service-matcher — pure path→serviceName extraction (strings.SplitN logic duplicated in HandleServiceHealth + HandleProxy, genuine dedup). NO auth-header-validator — gateway does ZERO auth today; would be artificial. Target dir pkg/primitive/. Each ≥3 scenarios (golden + edge + failure). Verify: CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=primitive -scenario=all exits 0; ≥1 failure scenario; grep net/http|httputil in pkg/primitive = 0 (no I/O in pure tier); ZERO-CREDS grep -iE 'token|secret|api_key|password' in pkg/primitive = 0 (trivially clean — gateway has no creds). Min 9 scenario files (3 prim × 3). architect+dev-api-gateway confirm exact band Phase 0/1; honest 3 is the expected and correct count.

goals.title: Module composes primitives via ports
goals.calibration: ONE module: pkg/module/gateway/ — composes the 3 routing primitives via interface + injected ports (HealthCheckerPort + ServiceRegistryPort already exist in pkg/domain/ports.go; reuse, do not duplicate). Multi-primitive scenario = a routing story: match service from path (route-service-matcher) → resolve downstream path (proxy-path-resolver) → for /health aggregate, fan-out + overall-status-computer derive ok/degraded/down. G2 is light-touch here per charter delta — architect confirms whether the existing AggregateHealthService/use-case layer already satisfies module composition or needs a thin pkg/module/gateway wrapper. Fence-B + no-I/O grep: grep pkg/module/ cross-module imports = 0; grep net/http|httputil direct dial in pkg/module = 0 (I/O only via injected ports). ≥1 multi-primitive sandbox scenario.

goals.title: Microservice has clean composition root
goals.calibration: cmd/server/main.go wires module + adapters; HealthChecker (net/http client) + StaticServiceRegistry injected HERE as infra impls of HealthCheckerPort/ServiceRegistryPort. Zero domain logic in root. Current main.go = 67 lines (already ≤80 — ADVANTAGE: gateway is mostly composition root already, per charter delta G3 win = declarative routing rules + auditable wiring). OpenAPI YAML in pkg/interface/http/ documenting the 5+1 routes (/health, /healthz, /health/:service, /health-dashboard, /api/*, /:service/*). Port = 4000 internal AND external (system-map.json api-gateway.port, never hardcoded). grep computeOverallStatus|ProxyPath|route-match in cmd/server/main.go = 0 (domain ops must not appear in root).

goals.title: Three-level dashboard renders from JSON traces
goals.calibration: NEW artifact apps/api-gateway/dashboard/index.html — 3 panels (primitives 3-card / module 1-card 'gateway' / microservice 1-card port 4000 from system-map.json label-only). DISTINCT from the existing RUNTIME health dashboard served by HandleDashboard/BuildDashboardHTML (handlers.go) — that is a live ops page; the TRUST dashboard renders from scenario TRACE JSON, file:// standalone, ZERO network calls, ZERO CDN/fetch/img. Charter delta G6–G9: narrative is honest to what a gateway does — 'routing rule /:service/* resolves to upstream Y' and 'overall-status-computer maps {ok,ok,down}→degraded', NOT 'RSI computed correctly'. Honest NOT-RUN cold-open. Renders from primitive/module trace JSON.

goals.title: Edit-JSON-and-rerun works (zero credentials in sandbox)
goals.calibration: User edits scenario JSON, refreshes dashboard, sees updated result. ZERO-CREDS is TRIVIALLY clean for api-gateway — the gateway has NO DB, NO Telegram, NO external API keys (pure HTTP routing/proxy); env audit forbidden list = standard DB_/API_KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASSWORD only (no service-specific keys). Sub-gates: (1) env audit: env | grep -iE 'DB_|API_KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD' in sandbox process returns empty; (2) scenario JSON grep -rniE 'token|secret|api_key|password' apps/api-gateway/cmd/sandbox/ = 0; (3) sandbox compiles under CGO_ENABLED=0 (api-gateway is go1.22 NO-CGO — simpler than stock-price/TA, no SQLite); (4) edit→rerun→updated-trace cycle works end-to-end (e.g. edit overall-status-computer scenario {ok,ok,down} expecting 'degraded', rerun, dashboard updates). Sandbox runner: CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=primitive -scenario=<file>. Edit-rerun handler: rerun-handler.js (Go/TS pattern). All 4 required.

goals.title: Red/green status is honest
goals.calibration: Two tests proven before G8 grades YES: Test A (deliberately corrupt a golden scenario — e.g. flip overall-status-computer expected {ok,ok,down}→'ok' instead of 'degraded', OR flip proxy-path-resolver expected stripped path) → dashboard RED, diff captured; Test B (known-good golden after revert) → dashboard GREEN, diff=null. No false green tolerated. Pattern identical across all pilots.

goals.title: Regression alarm bell works
goals.calibration: HIGHEST PRIORITY for api-gateway — charter delta: gateway is the single MCP-facing interface, a primitive/route regression has the WIDEST blast radius of any service. 2-trial coupling proof (TA cycle-17 / macro cycle-57 / alert-engine precedent). Trial-1 = G10 injection (overall-status-computer or proxy-path-resolver) + fix; verify ≥1 coupled scenario RED, single-edit fix repairs all coupled. Trial-2 = DIFFERENT primitive mutation (e.g. route-service-matcher) + fix; same coupling proof. Both trials outcome-(a) = PASS. Alarm-mechanism-functional. Given blast radius, architect should design a coupled scenario where a route/path regression visibly cascades (e.g. a path-strip bug surfaces in BOTH a proxy scenario AND a health-route scenario).

L-HONEST-3: api-gateway is lowest-domain-logic service (routing/proxy). G1 honest count = 3 real pure-function primitives (overall-status-computer, proxy-path-resolver, route-service-matcher). Do NOT manufacture artificial primitives (no auth-header-validator — gateway does zero auth). Honest 3 is correct and expected (charter delta).

L-NO-CGO/NO-CREDS: api-gateway is go1.22 NO-CGO (per system-map runtime — unlike stock-price/TA which are go1.22+cgo) and has ZERO credentials (no DB, no Telegram, no API keys). G7/ZERO-CREDS gate is trivially clean; CGO_ENABLED=0 sandbox builds with no SQLite concerns.

L-BLAST-RADIUS: gateway is the single MCP-facing interface routing to ALL services → widest regression blast radius of any pilot. G11 regression-canary is HIGHEST PRIORITY; design coupled scenarios where a route/path bug cascades across proxy + health routes.

L-NEW-NOT-PORT: api-gateway is a NEW Go service, not a TS-port. G5 light-touch — verify no legacy TS gateway exists; G5 may grade trivially-YES. The G3 'win' is declarative routing rules + auditable wiring, not deletion (main.go already 67L ≤80).
